claim: Direct acoustics did not solve reliable nasal feedback; fusion improves one explored correction but worsens other outcomes.

design.imputation: per-column finite training median; zero only if all training values missing
design.block_weights: each named block has equal aggregate standardized weight
design.pooling: MFCC/CMN: mean of each vowel third; formants: per-third log-frequency/log-bandwidth medians and missing fractions, both fixed ceilings concatenated
limits: Normal and erroneous training targets remain confounded with corpus source.
Both formant ceilings apply to every recording, not inferred speaker sex; child-specific ceilings not tested.
Formant poles are noisy acoustic measurements, not verified articulatory locations.
All evaluation cohorts explored; restored cohort shares speakers and one sentence.
Not a reproduction of the landmark paper, and not real-device or noisy-speech acceptance.

limitations: Annotation inventory only; no local audio matching, boundary verification, provider calls or scoring.
Four speakers only. No claim of independent multi-rater agreement per target.
Target positions are pinyin-token positions, not yet mapped to Chinese characters.
Strict entire-sequence filtering excludes other errors; it is not complete corpus error coverage.
